idea: EPS Admin AI automates medical authorizations for Peruvian EPS (health insurers) using localized AI trained on Peruvian clinical guidelines, extracting patient history from legacy systems, and providing explainable recommendations, reducing response time from minutes to seconds.

selected_gap.title: Localized AI for Peruvian Medical Context
selected_gap.pain: High – Foreign AI solutions often fail to account for local clinical guidelines, drug formularies, and Spanish medical jargon, leading to inaccurate decisions and increased manual overrides.
selected_gap.why_now: Cohere Health is expanding but lacks deep local adaptation; manual teams are overwhelmed. Early mover can capture the market by delivering superior accuracy.

selected_gap.risk: Competitors could quickly gather local data if they invest; regulatory shifts could require specific algorithm certifications.

idea: Instead of selling to EPS, we target large Peruvian employers who provide private health plans to their workforce. These employers currently bear the hidden costs of slow manual prior authorizations: employee frustration, delayed treatments, absenteeism, and lack of transparency. Our AI solution integrates with their existing health plan administration (TPA or self-insured setup) to instantly process pre-authorizations using Peruvian clinical guidelines and employee history, delivering approvals or denials with explanations in seconds. The employer pays an annual per-employee fee, gaining a dashboard with ROI tracking, cost savings, and employee satisfaction metrics. Only edge cases are escalated to human auditors. This shifts the buyer from health insurance companies to HR departments managing benefits, aligning with their urgency to improve employee wellness and control escalating healthcare costs while offering a localized, transparent alternative to manual processes.
